newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banespa jumps on upcoming deal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banespa jumps on upcoming deal.

text.p: Preferred shares of Brazilian state bank Banespa jumped 16.67 percent on expectations that a deal will be announced in the next few days that will convert it into a federal bank, stock market sources said.
Banespa preferred, which opened at 4.80 reais, reached 5.60 reais by 1230 local time/0930 EST on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange on trade of 130 million shares or about 700,000 reais.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares was up 0.38 percent at 66,705 points, with the rise led by Banespa preferred.

The share has surged by some 180 percent in the last eight sessions on news that Sao Paulo state, which owns the bank but owes it 20 billion reais, was close to a deal to transfer the institution to the federal government.
Banespa has been under Central Bank management since 1994 but the arrangement will expire December 31.
